camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2017-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2017-12-10T20:00:00Z'
description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData operation to query the total number and proportions of real-time HTTP return codes for a domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData查询域名实时HTTP返回码总数和占比数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-real-time-http-code-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the carrier.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query carriers. If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获取，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query regions. If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域商英文名。

您可以调用[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获取，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between data points, in seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

UsageData.description_en: A list of usage data for the proportions of return codes
UsageData.description_zh: 各返回码占比使用数据列表

TimeStamp.description_en: The start of the time slice

RealTimeCodeProportionData.description_en: The information about the return codes

Count.description_en: The total number of times the return code was returned

Proportion.description_en: The proportion of the return code

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range
